description: This file defines the StringValueBinder class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for binding values to spreadsheet cells with various conversion settings.
external_files: // Note: Assumed as part of dependencies for handling DateTimeInterface and associated date formatting
// Related to styling (e.g. setting quote prefix)

classes.name: StringValueBinder
classes.description: A class responsible for binding values to spreadsheet cells with configurable conversions such as null, boolean, numeric, and formula conversions.

methods.name: setNullConversion
methods.description: Sets whether null values should be converted when binding values.

methods.name: setBooleanConversion
methods.description: Sets whether boolean values should be converted when binding values.

methods.name: getBooleanConversion
methods.description: Returns the current configuration for boolean value conversion.

methods.name: setNumericConversion
methods.description: Sets whether numeric values (int and float) should be converted when binding.

methods.name: setFormulaConversion
methods.description: Sets whether formula strings (starting with '=') should be converted.

methods.name: setConversionForAllValueTypes
methods.description: Sets conversion options for all value types simultaneously.

methods.name: bindValue
methods.description: Binds a given value to a cell with appropriate type handling and conversion based on the set configurations.

methods.name: bindObjectValue
methods.description: Handles binding of object values, specifically DateTime and RichText objects.

search-terms: PHP class for cell value binding
